words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pass. √gṝ

hindi: सच्चा, उदार, वेगवान् वह आए; उसके भूरे-पीले घोड़े हमारे पास दौड़ें। उसके लिए हमने यहाँ यह अति बलवर्धक पोषक द्रव्य निचोड़ा है; स्तुति किया जाता हुआ वह आगमन करता है।
english: Let the true, bountiful, impetuous one come; let his tawny ones run towards us. For him we have pressed here this very strengthening nourishment; being praised, he makes his approach.
notes: Indra is not named in the verse. ṛjīṣin is a rare epithet; 'impetuous' is a guess, sense uncertain. andhas 'nourishment' (the pressed drink; not identified). abhipitvam karate 'makes approach / comes'. gṛṇānaḥ 'being praised' (pass. sense of the pres. part.).

hindi: हे शूर, आज हमारे इस सवन में आनन्दित होने के लिए, यात्रा के अन्त की तरह, खोल दो। उशना के समान भक्त स्तोत्र का पाठ करता है, जानने वाले के लिए, प्रभुता के लिए स्तुति।
english: Unyoke, O hero, as at the end of the road, in this pressing of ours today, to be exhilarated. The devout one, like Uśanā, recites the hymn, the praise, for the one who knows, for lordly power.
notes: ava sya = ava + sya (2 sg. impv. of ava-√so), 'unyoke'; adhvano nānte = adhvanaḥ na ante 'as at the end of the road' (na = 'like'). asuryāya: from asurya 'lordship, lordly power' (asura = lord). manma may be acc. sg. or pl. Sense of cikituṣe asuryāya (two datives) uncertain; vedhāḥ 'devout one, worshipper'.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. vi-√pā

hindi: जैसे द्रष्टा गुप्त यज्ञों को सिद्ध करता हुआ, जब वृषभ ने धारा को पीते हुए गान किया। इस प्रकार उसने द्युलोक से सात गायकों को उत्पन्न किया; दिन में भी उन्होंने स्तुति करते हुए ज्ञान से किया।
english: Like a seer accomplishing the hidden rites, when the bull, drinking up the outpouring, sang. Thus he begot from heaven the seven singers; even by day they did, praising, with insight.

text_flags.why: possible stray 'vṛ' (perhaps a repeat of the following vṛṣā); the form sādhan fits the sense and metre

notes: Obscure verse; translated literally. Source token 'sādha̱nvṛ' has stray 'vṛ' (see text_flags). arcāt: from √arc 'sing' (also 'shine'). The bull is not named. vayunā 'with insight' (also 'with the pattern / path'); cakruḥ has no stated object. divaḥ may be abl. or gen.

hindi: जब द्युलोक का सुन्दर दीखने वाला प्रकाश स्तुतियों से पाया गया, जब प्रभात में दोनों महान् ज्योतियाँ चमकीं, तब सबसे अधिक पौरुषवान् ने मनुष्यों के देखने के लिए अन्धे अन्धकारों को दूर कर दिया, आक्रमण में।
english: When the light of heaven, beautiful to see, was found by means of chants, when the two great lights shone at dawn, the most manly one drove off the blind darknesses, for men to see, in the assault.
notes: jyotī (with mahi) taken as n. dual or plural 'lights'. vastoḥ 'at dawn' (loc. or gen. of vastu). dudhitā: ppp. of √dhū, 'driven off, shaken off' (sense uncertain). abhiṣṭau: 'in the assault' (also 'in help'). dudhitā is a predicate: literally 'made the blind darknesses driven off'. Source ṷ marks are notation.

hindi: इन्द्र वेगवान् ने अपरिमित रूप से बल पाया है; महिमा से उसने दोनों लोकों को भर दिया है। इससे भी परे उसकी महिमा निकल गई है, जो सब भुवनों के ऊपर हो गया है।
english: Indra, the impetuous, has grown strong immeasurably; by greatness he has filled both worlds. Even beyond this his greatness stands out, he who has become superior to all the worlds.
notes: vavakṣa: 3 sg. pf. of √vakṣ, 'has grown strong' (src vavakṣa is 3 sg., agreeing with indraḥ). ubhe rodasī 'both worlds' (rodasī = the two worlds). vi reci: 3 sg. aor. pass. of vi-√ric 'is left over / stands out beyond'. abhi babhūva 'has become superior to, surpassed'. ṛjīṣī as in 4.16.1 uncertain.

hindi: सब पौरुष के कार्यों को जानने वाले शक्तिशाली ने उत्सुक साथियों के साथ जलों को छोड़ा। जिन्होंने वाणियों से चट्टान को भी फोड़ा, उन उशिजों ने गौओं से भरे बाड़े को खोल दिया।
english: The mighty one, knowing all manly deeds, released the waters with eager companions. Those who split even the rock with words, the Uśijs, opened the cattle-rich pen.
notes: apaḥ taken as 'waters' (acc. pl. of ap); apas 'works' is formally possible. ye ... uśijaḥ: Uśij is kept as a name for a class of sacrificers. nikāma 'eager, desiring'.

hindi: जलों को घेरे हुए वृत्र को तुमने दूर मारा; तुम्हारे वज्र की पृथिवी ने एकमत होकर सहायता की। तुमने समुद्र की बाढ़ों को आगे बढ़ाया, बल से स्वामी होते हुए, हे शूर, हे धृष्णु।
english: You struck away Vṛtra who had enclosed the waters; Earth, of one mind, helped your vajra. You set the sea's floods in motion, becoming lord by strength, O hero, O bold one.
notes: apaḥ is taken with vavrivāṃsam ('had enclosed the waters'). parā han: 2 sg. injunctive. arṇāṃsi samudriyāṇi 'floods of the sea'; patiḥ has no stated dependent genitive.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pass. √gṝ

hindi: हे बहुतों से आहूत, जब तुमने जलों को, चट्टान को फोड़ा, तब सरमा पहले तुम्हारे सामने प्रकट हुई। हमारे नेता के रूप में तुम प्रचुर पुरस्कार खोलते हो, गोष्ठों को तोड़ता हुआ, अङ्गिरसों द्वारा स्तुति किया जाता हुआ।
english: When, O much-invoked one, you split the waters, the rock, Saramā first became manifest to you. As our leader, you break open abundant prize, shattering the cattle-pens, being praised by the Aṅgirases.
notes: Uncertain construction in line 1: apaḥ and adrim are both accusatives of dardaḥ ('split the waters, the rock'); pūrvyam te 'first to you' (pūrvyam adverbial; 'your first/ancient [one]' is the other reading). In line 2 saḥ (3rd person) goes with 2 sg. darṣi; translated 'As our leader, you ...'. ā darṣi 'break open'.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. mid. √nādh

hindi: हे पौरुष-मन वाले, तुम स्तुति करने वाले द्रष्टा की ओर सहायता में, प्रकाश की प्राप्ति में गए, हे उदार, याचना करते हुए की ओर। सहायताओं से उसे, हे प्रेरक, यश के आह्वान में; मायावी, प्रार्थनाहीन दस्यु नीचे गिर गया।
english: You went towards the seer, O manly-minded one, in help, in the winning of light, O bountiful one, towards the imploring one. With helps, him, O impelling one, in the call for glory: the deceitful, prayerless Dasyu sank down.
notes: Uncertain. gāḥ taken as 2 sg. aor. injunctive of √gā 'went' (acchā ... gāḥ); gāḥ 'cows' (acc. pl.) is the other possibility. nādhamānam is the sandhi of maghavan + nādhamānam. The construction of tam ... iṣaṇaḥ is unclear (no verb for 'him'). ni arta: 'sank down / fell' (ni-√ṛ), or 'was cast down'. Source ṷ marks are notation.

hindi: दस्युओं को मारने वाले मन से घर आओ; तुम्हारी मित्रता में कुत्स उत्सुक हो। हे समान रूप वालो, अपने स्थान में बैठो; ऋत को जानने वाली स्त्री ने तुम दोनों को अलग पहचान लिया है।
english: Come home with a Dasyu-slaying mind; let Kutsa be eager in friendship with you. Sit down in the own seat, you two of like form; the woman, indeed perceiving order, has distinguished you two.
notes: The second line is obscure: sve yonau 'in the own seat' (no possessive supplied), vi vām cikitsat 'has distinguished you two' (sense uncertain; the two addressed are not named). ṛta = order. sakhye with te: 'in friendship with you' / 'in your friendship'.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √īś
m. nom. sg. pres. part. desid. √yu

hindi: तुम कुत्स के साथ एक ही रथ में जाते हो, सहायता चाहते हुए, प्रेरक, वायु के दोनों भूरे-पीले घोड़ों पर शासन करते हुए। तेज़ वे, पकड़ने योग्य पुरस्कार की तरह, जोड़ने की इच्छा करते हुए; जब द्रष्टा दिन में पूर्ति के लिए सेवा करे।
english: You go with Kutsa in the same chariot, seeking help, the urger, ruling over the two tawny horses of the wind. The swift ones, like a prize to be seized, wishing to unite; when the seer would attend on the day for completion.
notes: Line 2 is very obscure; translated literally without a firm sense. ṛjrā: form uncertain (swift ones / swift, nom. du. or acc. pl.); yuyūṣan (desid. of √yu) 'wishing to unite' is a guess; ahan taken as loc. of ahar 'on the day'; pāryāya 'for completion'; bhūṣāt 3 sg. subj. of √bhūṣ. todaḥ might also be taken as a name or epithet 'urger'.

hindi: कुत्स के लिए तुमने अशुष शुष्ण को, दिन के आरम्भ पर, कुयव को, हज़ारों को नीचे गिराया। तुरन्त दस्युओं को कुत्स्य के साथ कुचल दो; सूर्य के चक्र को आगे खींच लो, संग्राम में।
english: For Kutsa you laid low Śuṣṇa the unwithering, at the approach of the day, Kuyava, thousands. At once crush the Dasyus with the Kutsa-ite; tear forth the sun's wheel in the encounter.
notes: Uncertain. aśuṣa 'unwithering' is a guess (could be 'insatiable'). kuyavam sahasrā: Kuyava and 'thousands' stand side by side without a connecting word; 'thousands' may be an adverbial or a second object. kutsyena (inst. of kutsya 'belonging to Kutsa') left as 'the Kutsa-ite'. sūraḥ cakram: sūraḥ is a nominative form; taken as 'of the sun'. vṛhatāt 2/3 sg. impv. in -tāt; prapitve 'at the approach / onset'.

hindi: तुमने बलवान् हुए पिप्रु, मृगय को ऋजिश्वा वैदथिन के वश में कर दिया। पचास हज़ार काले लोगों को तुमने नीचे गिराया; तुमने गढ़ों को फाड़ डाला, जैसे बुढ़ापा वस्त्र को।
english: You delivered Pipru, Mṛgaya, who had grown strong, to Ṛjiśvan Vaidathina. You cast down fifty thousand dark ones; you tore apart the strongholds, like old age a garment.
notes: piprum mṛgayam taken as two names side by side (Pipru, Mṛgaya); 'Pipru the Mṛgaya' is possible. Vaidathina taken as a name/patronymic (not explained). randhīḥ 'you delivered / made subject'. jarimā na atkam: 'as old age (tears) a garment' (verb shared from vi dardaḥ). pur 'stronghold' per glossary.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √dhā
m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √uṣ

hindi: सूर्य, समीप शरीर को धारण करता हुआ, जब तुम्हारा अमर का रूप स्पष्ट रूप से दिखाई देने योग्य है। जंगली पशु, हाथी के समान बल को जलाता हुआ, भयंकर सिंह के समान शस्त्र धारण करता हुआ।
english: The sun, placing a body near, when your form, that of the immortal, is distinctly to be perceived — like a wild beast, an elephant, burning strength, like a fearsome lion bearing weapons.
notes: Obscure. sūraḥ (nom. sg.) is taken as 'Sūra, the sun'; its relation to te amṛtasya varpaḥ is unclear. uṣāṇaḥ (√uṣ 'burn') is uncertain, taviṣīm uṣāṇaḥ 'burning strength' is literal; mṛgaḥ na hastī may be 'like a wild beast, an elephant' (hastin) or 'like a beast with a hand'. Source digit mark in tanvaṃ1 is a svara mark.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. denom. √vasūy

words.gloss: in the contest for light (sense uncertain)

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pf. part. mid. √kan
m. nom. pl. pf. part. mid. √śam

hindi: धन चाहने वाली कामनाएँ इन्द्र के पास गई हैं, प्रकाश की स्पर्धा में जैसे सवन में आनन्द लेती हुई। यश चाहने वाले, स्तोत्रों से परिश्रम करते हुए, सुखद घर के समान, सुन्दर दिखने वाले पोषण के समान।
english: Desires, seeking wealth, have gone to Indra, delighting at the pressing as in the contest for light. Seeking fame, toiling with hymns — like a pleasant home, like beautiful nourishment.
notes: Obscure. svarmīḻhe (svar-mīḻha, 'contest for light'?) is uncertain; the t before svar- is the regular t after final n. Line 2 has no stated link to line 1 (the subject of śaśamānāsaḥ, 'those seeking fame', is not stated). okaḥ na raṇvā: gender/number of raṇvā unclear.

hindi: उसी इन्द्र को, सुखपूर्वक बुलाए जाने वाले को, तुम्हारे लिए हम बुलाएँ, जिसने वे बहुत-से पौरुष कार्य किए; जो मेरे जैसे स्तोता के लिए पकड़ने योग्य पुरस्कार भी शीघ्र लाता है, जिसकी दान-शक्ति वांछनीय है।
english: Let us call, for you, that very Indra, easily called, who did those many manly deeds; who quickly brings, to a singer like me, even the prize that is to be seized, he whose bounty is desirable.
notes: vaḥ taken as dat. 'for you' (pl.). naryā 'manly deeds' (n. pl. adj. used as noun). gadhyam vājam 'prize to be seized'.

hindi: जब तीखा अस्त्र भीतर गिरता है, हे शूर, लोगों के किसी क्षण में, जब शत्रु की भयानक टक्कर होती है, तब निश्चय ही हमारे शरीर के रक्षक होकर ध्यान दो।
english: When the sharp missile falls within, O hero, in some moment of the peoples, when the dreadful clash of the foe happens, then indeed take heed, guardian of our body.
notes: arya for aryaḥ: form uncertain (gen. sg. of ari/arya 'foe, stranger' or 'lord'); translated 'of the foe'. kasmiñcit muhuke janānām literal 'in some moment of the peoples'. tanvaḥ gen. sg. 'of the body' (could be taken with gopāḥ).

hindi: वामदेव की धी-स्तुतियों के रक्षक बनो; मित्र बनो, हानि न करने वाले, पुरस्कार की प्राप्ति में। तुम्हारे पीछे हम पूर्वविचार तक आए हैं; हे बहुत प्रशंसित, तुम स्तोता के लिए सदा रहो।
english: Be the helper of Vāmadeva's thoughts; be a friend, harmless, in the winning of prize. Following you we have come to forethought; may you, widely praised, be always for the singer.
notes: bhuvaḥ taken as injunctive with imperative force ('be'); 'you became' is possible. avṛka 'harmless' (lit. 'not wolf-like'). pramatim 'forethought, care'; anu ... ā jaganma 'following, we have come to'. viśvadha 'always, at all times'.

hindi: इन मनुष्यों के साथ, हे इन्द्र, जो तुम्हें चाहते हैं, तुम्हें, उदार लोगों के साथ, हे उदार, सब संग्राम में। द्युलोकों के समान तेजों से शत्रुओं पर प्रबल होते हुए हम रातों में और बहुत शरद् ऋतुओं में आनन्दित हों।
english: With these men, O Indra, who desire you, you, with the bountiful, O bountiful one, all in the contest. Like the heavens with splendours, being superior over the foes, may we be exhilarated through the nights and the many autumns.
notes: Line 1 has no finite verb in the unit and the grammar of 'tvā' and 'viśva ājau' is unclear; 'viśva' is taken as viśve 'all' (nom. pl.), form uncertain. aryaḥ taken as acc. pl. 'foes' (arya/ari; 'lords' or 'strangers' also possible). abhi santaḥ 'being superior to'. kṣapaḥ ... śaradaḥ 'through the nights ... autumns' (acc. of duration).

hindi: इस प्रकार इन्द्र के लिए, वृषभ के लिए, पौरुषवान् के लिए हमने ब्रह्म किया है, भृगुओं के रथ के समान। अब ही जिससे वह मित्रता से अलग करे, और वह हमारा बलवान् रक्षक, शरीर की रक्षा करने वाला हो।
english: Thus for Indra, the bull, the manly one, we have made a prayer, like the Bhṛgus a chariot. So that he might now separate from friendship, and be a mighty helper for us, the protector of the body.
notes: Unclear: yathā ... viyoṣat 'so that he might separate (us) from friendship' reads against the sense (a negative 'not' would be expected) but the source has none; translated literally, sakhyā (abl. or inst.) and the object of viyoṣat are not stated. bhṛgavo na ratham 'like the Bhṛgus (made) a chariot'. brahma 'prayer'.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. pass. √gṝ

hindi: अब स्तुत किए गए, हे इन्द्र, अब गाए जाते हुए, स्तोता के लिए स्फूर्ति को नदियों के समान बढ़ाओ। हे भूरे-पीले घोड़ों के स्वामी, तुम्हारे लिए नया ब्रह्म किया गया है; धी से हम रथों के स्वामी, सदा विजयी हों।
english: Now praised, O Indra, now being sung, make refreshment swell for the singer, like rivers. A new prayer has been made for you, O lord of the tawny horses; by thought may we be chariot-owners, always winning.
notes: pīpeḥ taken as 2 sg. opt. of √pī 'swell' used as an imperative. rathyaḥ 'chariot-owners' (also 'charioteers'); sadāsāḥ uncertain ('always winning / always bestowing'). Same verse as 4.17.21.
